- **One spelling:** the run-record kinds are spelled once, as `RUN_RECORD_LABELS = ['qa-run','eval-run']`. The sweep's `EXCLUDED_LABELS` (R1), `H13_EXEMPT_LABELS` and `H74_EXEMPT_LABELS` (R2), and `GRADELESS_CARD_LABELS` (R6) all spread it, so the next record kind is added in one place.

- **R3:** the only North Star change is the sentence 「A record card (`qa-run`, `eval-run`) takes no area either.」, inserted after the record/epic type sentence.
- **R4:** removes the two stopgap lines in `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` and nothing else.
- **Self-tests:** the sweep has 67 cases (63 on main) and half-states has 5359 (5356). Battery floors sit at their counts. Ablation 1: dropping the epic clause turns 1 of 67 red. Ablation 2: cutting `eval-run` from the shared list turns 4 of 5359 and 4 of 67 red. Both restored to HEAD.

Overlap is clean.
- **Live sweep, main vs this branch:** row ① and the area row drop the open eval record. The type row goes from 6 cards to 1, dropping the 4 epics and the eval record.
- **Brief:** four business lines. The last line asks the maintainer to review the North Star sentence and merge.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `802e86d475b3cbd6c80476d1da6db3b82b4a86da`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, .claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md, docs/NORTH-STAR.md + scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs

PR #35532 for card #35470, judged against ruling record 7008518427 on the card (E2, option A: run-record cards take no `area:*`, eval records go the QA way). The two scripts are the whole rest of the diff, so no path is left to a lane ACCEPT. Tier H: `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is in the diff, so a maintainer approval is owed whatever this record says.

### ① Derived judgments

Gates, read off the head's check-runs at 2026-11-19 14:36Z, every run concluded: 57 runs, 34 success, 23 skipped, none red, none pending. The ones that answer this diff:

- `Lint · repo & tooling gates`: success. It runs `pnpm check:pm-half-states`, the self-test that carries the new H13, H74 and H78 cases.
- `Live half-state sweep`: success. The PR's own `check-half-states.mjs` read the live board and closed cards to the end.
- `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Platform checklist gate sweep`, `PR-body guards`: success.

K = 6 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `f727061b88` (`main` at `d76d57ab46`). None touches a file of this diff.

One gate has no check-run, and the diff did not cause that: no workflow and no `package.json` alias names `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`, so its `--self-test` ran on no CI job. Its result on this head rests on the dev's local run. I read the changed pins statically instead of running it: the phrase at `first-touch-sweep.mjs:109` is a verbatim substring of `triage-duties.md:18`; `TYPE_EXEMPT_PHRASE` (`:119`) is in `triage-duties.md:66`; the two raised floors equal the cases I counted in their batteries (classifier 20, backstop 17; 3 + 20 + 8 + 10 + 9 + 17 = 67, the total the PR states).

Accept-set changes the diff implies, each judged:

| Change | Where | Judged |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `eval-run` joins the sweep's exclusions, so a card carrying it leaves ①–⑤ and both backstop rows | `first-touch-sweep.mjs:127`, read at `:154`, `:175`, `:193`, `:201` | right: R1 of the ruling |
| `pm:epic` leaves the type row only; the area row and `classify` are untouched | `first-touch-sweep.mjs:191-195` | right: R5; `NORTH-STAR.md:139` and `triage-duties.md:66` say an epic takes no type, and the card says the area row stays |
| `eval-run` joins H13's exemptions | `check-half-states.mjs:3842` | right: R2 |
| `eval-run` joins H74's exemptions and its finding text | `check-half-states.mjs:8413`, `:8576` | right: R2 |
| `qa-run` and `eval-run` join the gradeless kinds, so H78 is silent on an ungraded record that something waits on | `check-half-states.mjs:4113`, read at `:4189` | right: R6; a record that does carry a grade is still reported |
| New exports `RUN_RECORD_LABELS`, `TYPE_EXEMPT_PHRASE`, `EPIC_LABEL` | both scripts | internal script surface; no published package reads them |

Public surface: none. No file under `packages/**`, no schema, no generated output.

### ② Semver level

Five files: two under `.claude/skills/`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, two under `scripts/pm/`. Nothing published moves, so no changeset is owed; the PR carries `skip-changeset` and `Check Changeset` is green.

Clause-②: no. It holds: no published schema and no published accept-set changes. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds for the same reason.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the dev report. Nothing to answer.
- Dev note, the sweep's ③ and #34571. Judged here, ungraded, because the diff does not touch it: **it is a real defect in the sweep, and a small one.** The rule phrase 「③ `area:*` 无 pm-state」 (`triage-duties.md:17`) is read by two instruments with two vocabularies. The sweep reads the six mutually exclusive positions (`first-touch-sweep.mjs:159`, `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`, `pm:epic` out). H13 reads `PM_STATE_LABELS` (`check-half-states.mjs:3798`), whose own docblock says it mirrors disjunct ③ and which counts `pm:epic` because the epic index reads it. The rule side leans H13's way: the label table gives `pm:epic` its own meaning (reserved by the epic PM, never beside `pm:queue`), a parent card is never dispatched (`triage-duties.md:72`), and no line asks an epic for one of the six positions. Size, read on the board at 14:27Z: one card. #34571 carries `pm:epic`, `area:ux`, `priority:p2` and no position; the other three open epics carry `pm:on-hold` or `pm:dispatched` and are silent. The row is inside the owed set, so each fire reports FOUND where it would report CLEAN, and `triage-duties.md:20` allows no per-card waiver, so the only way to clear it is to write a position onto an epic the maintainer opened. It is bounded: report-only, the exit code is 0 either way, no gate reads it, and it grows by one card per stateless epic. It is unchanged between `main` and this branch, and the card kept R5 to the type row, so leaving it out was right. It wants its own `area:fleet` card through the filing gate. The fix is one line either way (③ counts `pm:epic` as H13 does, or the rule says an epic owes a position), and which of the two is the rule owner's call; the sweep's self-test pins neither today.
- Dev note, `check:platform-checklist` red locally on `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`: `Platform checklist gate sweep` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` are green on this head, so the local reading did not reproduce in CI. Nothing is owed by this PR.
- Dev deviations: two instruction conflicts, both resolved toward the repo text. The 速读 block has the four business lines, and the commit trailer names no model.
- SQL push-down: no data-path code in the diff. Nothing to check.
- Author: the PR was opened by the fleet App; no outside login to name.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` — the one sentence, for the maintainer's approval**

The sentence is: "A record card (`qa-run`, `eval-run`) takes no area either." It sits at `:139`, in Priority rule 2, Grading step one, directly after "types go only on cards with work to do." Nothing else in the file moves (one line changed, and the only difference inside it is this sentence).

- What it says: a QA or eval run record, the issue labelled `qa-run` or `eval-run`, carries no `area:*`, on top of the no type and no grade the sentence before it already gives a record card.
- Against the ruling: it is the first half of option A as recorded on the card. The second half, eval records go the QA way, is not North Star text; `triage-duties.md:18` and the four exemption lists carry it.
- What it changes in practice: a run record shows on no area board and is found by its label. No card needs relabelling for it: both skills already file records with the one label (`checklist-test/SKILL.md:146`, `scenario-eval/SKILL.md:125`), and the six `eval-run` cards on the board carry that label alone.
- What it does not change: work about evals (a runner fix, a finding from a round) still goes to `area:ai` under `:33`. Epic, tracking and anchor cards are not covered; only the two labels named are.
- What stays beside it: `:13` still says "every public card carries exactly one `area:*` label", and the new sentence is its exception, 126 lines further down (N1).

维护者读法:北极星第 139 行(定级第一步)只加了一句,质检与评测的运行记录(`qa-run`、`eval-run`)不带 `area:*`。这是 E2 裁决 A 的前半句;后半句「评测照质检办」不进北极星,由分诊规则第 18 行和四张豁免名单承载。影响:运行记录不出现在任何专题看板里,只按标签找;关于评测的工作卡仍归 `area:ai`。第 13 行「每张公开卡恰带一个 area」原句没动,新句是它的例外,要不要在那里补半句由您批准时定(N1)。

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`**

`:18` now excludes `qa-run` and `eval-run` records, and the pin at `first-touch-sweep.mjs:109` follows it word for word. Against the accepted scenario: #34842, the open `eval-run` record, carries that label alone, so `classify` returns nothing for it and both backstop rows skip it, which is the row the live delta in the PR body shows leaving. The file stays at 108 lines, its ratchet ceiling. The type exemption R5 leans on was already at `:66` and is now pinned.

**`.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`**

The two removed lines were a stopgap that named its own end ("在它补进之前"). The exclusion they waited for lands in the same commit, so they would be false on `main` after this merge. What remains holds: `:125` files the record with the one label, and `:145` closes it once every finding has a destination. Nothing else in the skill changes.

**`scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`**

The header (`:33-34`, `:58-63`), `EXCLUDED_LABELS` (`:127`) and `lacksType` (`:191-195`) agree with the rule text sentence by sentence. `lacksArea` and `classify` are untouched, as the card required, and the new cases pin both sides: an epic draws no type row (`:568`), an epic with no area still draws the area row and `pm:epic` is no exclusion (`:568-569`), and a record with the one label owes nothing (`:498`).

**`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`**

`RUN_RECORD_LABELS` (`:3835`) is frozen and read by the four lists the card names. The H13 and H74 cases and the H78 case sit beside working positive controls (the ungraded `pm:queue` blocker at `:29598` fires on the same fixture), and the exact-list pin at `:29774` reds on any drift of the H74 list.

Tried to break it:

- A card carrying `eval-run` beside work labels would vanish from every row. The board has six `eval-run` cards, open and closed, and all six carry that label alone (see N4 for the rule gap).
- A run record that carries a grade and blocks a higher-graded card is still reported by H78: the exemption applies only when the card is ungraded (`:4189`).
- `PM:Epic` in any case is read as the epic label, and a claimed epic with no area still draws the area row (`:568-569`).
- No import cycle: `check-half-states.mjs` does not import the sweep.

Nits, none with an effect on correctness or the contract. None is fixed here: each fix would move a reviewed file.

- N1 (nit): `NORTH-STAR.md:13` and the `area:*` row of the pm-dispatch label table (`SKILL.md:126`, 「每张公开卡恰一个,本仓安全卡不打」) stay unqualified beside the new exception. The specific sentence governs, and every instrument that asks a card for an area now exempts run records, so no reader is sent the wrong way. The ruling asked for one sentence; whether `:13` gets a half-clause is the maintainer's call at approval, or a follow-up.
- N2 (nit): the ruling says "run-record cards"; the sentence says "A record card" and names the two labels in parentheses. "Record card" is not defined in the North Star, so the parenthesis can read as a definition or as a restriction. The labels make the scope exact either way, and no instrument reads the term.
- N3 (nit): the `RUN_RECORD_LABELS` docblock (`check-half-states.mjs:3826-3833`) is loose in three places. H13 asks for a pm state and H74 for a triage audit, not for an area, a type or a grade. "A new record kind is one edit here" leaves out the literal in H74's finding text (`:8576`), the rule sentence with its pin, and the North Star parenthesis. And `eval-run` is also the label of the skill-eval records `lanes/eval.md:19` and `:30` file outside `scenario-eval` §5; #34842 is one. No behaviour depends on any of it.
- N4 (nit): the eval route is not yet the QA route in two rule lines this card did not order. `scenario-eval` §6 has no twin of RUNNER's "A defect card does not carry `qa-run`", and `lanes/eval.md` has no round-end read of open `eval-run` records like `lanes/qa.md:20`. With the label now excluded everywhere, a finding filed with it, or a record left open (#34842, open since 11-17), is read by no patrol. A follow-up card for the skills owner, through the filing gate.

Outside the diff, ungraded: the missing CI job for the sweep's self-test (①) and the ③ epic row (③) each want their own card.
